title: ArdourCraft Unicode Remade
description: This is a remake of the ArdourCraft Unicode resource pack, which adds custom unicode characters for the ArdourCraft SMP
body:
# A resource pack made by Amy Canoria for her Minecraft server

ArdourCraft Unicode Remade is a remake of a resource pack made by and for the ArdourCraft server. As of the latest version, ArdourCraft Unicode Remade adds 49 characters in the Unicode Private Use Area, divided into the following blocks:

- U+E000 to U+E01F - Helqese
- U+E020 to U+E03F - Neschan

If you want to contribute to the development of ArdourCraft Unicode, make sure to hop on over to the [Amy's Wolf Den](https://discord.gg/edGNN76EpU) Discord server.
